name: ant
description: A colony of disposable subagents. The main thread orchestrates and decides; ants do the throwaway investigation in isolated threads and bring back only the conclusion plus a pin.

interface.shortDescription: Keep throwaway investigation out of the main thread
interface.longDescription: Eight ants claimed by cognitive state — what you know versus what you don't. Each runs in its own thread, burns the exploration there, and returns a conclusion with a verifiable pin.
defaultPrompt: Use $ant-agent:ant-dispatch to hand this investigation to an ant
Use $ant-agent:ant-dispatch to set up the ant roles in this project
